tonight.title: Model Citizen
tonight.why: For a heart-pounding ride that pits man and beast against the unforgiving Alaskan wild, look no further. This survival epic delivers raw intensity and an unbreakable bond that will leave you cheering.

releases.title: Ebenezer
releases.take: This holiday classic gets a spectral makeover, proving that even the most hardened hearts can be haunted into finding some seasonal cheer.

releases.title: Heart of the Beast
releases.take: Forget The Revenant, this is the ultimate man-and-his-best-friend survival tale, where the only thing colder than the Alaskan wilderness is the odds of making it out alive.

releases.title: Resident Evil
releases.take: One delivery, one delivery, and suddenly Bryan's fighting for more than just overtime—he's fighting for his life in a chaotic horror show.

critic.title: Ebenezer
critic.blurb: Sometimes you need a story that reminds you of the sheer power of myth and the enduring human spirit. "The Odyssey" is a masterclass in epic storytelling, a journey worth every single one of its legendary trials.
